description: Compose a mix from a catalog and emit a pack JSON. Purpose 'training' (default) emits a flare-harvest-library v1 pack with coverage scores for model training data. Purpose 'code' emits a flare-harvest-codepack v1: a parts bin an agent can pull (harvest.pull) and build from — no coverage scoring. No Bridge stanza included.

catalog.description: Candidate items (e.g. from harvest.search). Full HarvestItem objects preferred.

goal.description: What the pack is for: a training goal ('small vision-language model') or a code build goal ('add rate-limiting to my API').

purpose.description: Pack purpose. 'training' (default) scores the mix for training-data coverage; 'code' builds a code build pack an agent pulls and builds from.

name: harvest.pack
